description: This file implements HTTP server setup and request handling for MCP (Model Context Protocol) in a Playwright-related project. It includes functions to start the server, handle SSE and streamable HTTP transports, and manage sessions.

methods.name: startMcpHttpServer
methods.description: Starts an MCP HTTP server with given configuration and backend factory, returning the server URL.

methods.name: addressToString
methods.description: Converts a network address object or string to a URL string with protocol and port.
